services.desc: Charles Evans Hughes was one of the most influential-and often overlooked-figures in American history. As Governor of New York, Supreme Court Justice, Chief Justice, and national leader, Hughes fought corruption, championed civil rights, modernized government, reformed industry, and helped shape the United States for the 20th century. In this talk, Bill will share insights from his new book, Charles Evans Hughes: Leadership at America’s Crossroads, with a special focus on Hughes’ connections to Glens Falls and the surrounding region. Discover the remarkable story of a leader whose influence continues to shape American history. This program is free for Chapman Members or $10 for non-members.
